subject: MAP: Close wobble — mitigation & final gating plan
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:24:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & target close (Novacorp / Redwood)

Hey Sean —

Quick heads-up: procurement has flagged a new approval gating that pushes our internal contracting timeline out by at least two weeks. This means our target close of 2026-12-01 is at risk unless we surface a short-term mitigation that lets us start commercial onboarding work without the final contract in place.

Can you send an updated MAP that outlines (a) a minimal set of activities we can start while procurement completes signatures, (b) the specific decision points blocking legal/procurement, and (c) a recommended re-baseline for close?

Attached: procurement_timeline.pdf (procurement's timeline and checklist)

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Product Operations, Novacorp

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-16T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & target close (Novacorp / Redwood)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the heads-up and the procurement timeline. I pulled the MAP forward and attached a short mitigation playbook. High level:
- Proposed re-baseline close: 2026-12-15 (two-week buffer)
- Start-able activities (pre-sign): sandbox provisioning, pilot data ingestion (limited scope), security questionnaire exchange under NDA
- Risk log (snapshot attached) enumerates gating items: legal language (data residency), invoicing entity, and SOC evidence timeline

If Novacorp agrees to the pre-sign sandbox + limited data ingestion, we can begin the evaluation cadence (weekly check-ins, technical runbook validation) and keep your product team productive while procurement finishes.

Action items I propose for this week:
1) Procurement confirms which contract clause requires executive sign-off (Daniel?) — due Tues 11/18
2) Redwood to provision sandbox and assign a CS engineer for pilot — due Wed 11/17
3) Legal to circulate redlines we can triage in a focused call — propose Thu 11/19

Attachments: novacorp_map_v3.xlsx, risk_log_snapshot.png

If you want, we can lock in a short executive call (15 min) to approve the pre-sign pilot approach.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0167

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:37:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP mitigation & risk log — runbook and temporary capacity

Team —

Reviewed Sean's MAP and the risk snapshot. A few tech / commercial levers we can use to reduce close risk:

- Temporary Dedicated pool (30 days) to guarantee throughput for the pilot; can be scoped to the pilot's token/sec profile.
- Short-term SLOs (alpha tier) for evaluation to avoid full production SLAs until contract is final.
- Offer a one-time 30% onboarding credit to offset any perceived operational risk for Novacorp.

If we go this route, we should document the gating in a short addendum (non-contractual), and publish a decision log under the MAP. This keeps procurement comfortable that we aren't shipping live without a contract, while enabling their product team to validate integration.

Suggested internal actions:
- Kar, can you prepare a minimal runbook (network + credentials + data handling) by EOD Tue 12/01?
- Sean, pls confirm you want me to escalate to Marissa for approval on the credit.

Attachment: technical_runbook.md (stub)

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T10:15:00-05:00
Subject: Escalation: temporary pilot proposal & approval request

Olivia / Daniel —

Following internal review, Redwood can provision a limited Dedicated pilot environment and assign a named CS engineer to Novacorp immediately. We propose a 30-day pilot credit and alpha-SLOs while procurement completes final contracting.

To make this formal: I've looped in Marissa (our sales leader) to approve the commercial credit and sign off on the pilot gating terms. If you can confirm that procurement is comfortable with a non-binding addendum outlining the pilot scope, we will proceed with provisioning on Wed 12/03.

Proposed updated close: 2026-12-20 (final contract execution) — this gives procurement 17 days to complete approvals after the pilot start.

On our side, next steps once you confirm:
- Provision sandbox & onboarding (Laura/Karthik) — target 12/03
- Weekly evaluation check-ins (Thu mornings) — first call 12/10
- Joint decision gate at day 20 of pilot to confirm go/no-go and sign date

Please reply with a simple OK from procurement and legal, or flag any blockers.

—Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:47:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: temporary pilot proposal & approval request

Olivia / team —

Thanks for the patience here. I approve the 30-day onboarding credit and the temporary Dedicated pilot under the terms Sean outlined. Procurement's non-binding addendum is fine as long as it clearly states the pilot is contingent on final contract sign. We'll also prioritize a SOC package acceleration — legal will share the evidence bundle directly with Daniel by 12/13.

We agree to re-baseline the close to 2026-12-20. Sean — please record this as the MAP decision and update the risk log with the credit and pilot gating. Laura / Kar — proceed with provisioning and the runbook.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
